newsitem.title: UK: David S. Smith down after Merrill downgrade.
newsitem.headline: David S. Smith down after Merrill downgrade.

text.p: Shares in paper and packaging group David S Smith Plc dropped on Friday after analysts at Merrill Lynch cut the stock to "reduce" from "accumulate," market sources said.
The stock was down 9p at 281-1/2 by 0940 GMT in slim volume of 44,323 shares.

Market sources said the Merrill downgrade reflected fears that the strength of sterling against continental European currencies was making trading difficult. The brokerage was said to be expecting a drop in David S. Smith's earnings per share to 24p in fiscal 1997, from 30.3p the year before.
For 1998 it expects earnings of 27.6p, sources said. Analysts at Merrill were not immediately available for comment.
